newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil troops protect govt buildings after riot.
newsitem.headline: Brazil troops protect govt buildings after riot.

text.p: Brazilian troops were protecting several goverment buildings in the city of Belo Horizonte on Wednesday after striking police officers rioted while demonstrating for more pay, an official said.
"The army will continue to give its support in maintaining order and protecting public property," a spokesman for the Minas Gerais state government said.
He said hundreds of troops remained in positions around the state capitol and other buildings in the city.
A police officer was shot in the head during a clash on Tuesday between police protecting the governor's palace and hundreds of striking colleagues demanding a pay increase.
The officer was in critical condition in a hospital and detectives were trying to identify a man who was filmed firing a pistol during the disturbances, the spokesman said.
